method: Make the filling first. Get the pan properly hot, add the chickpeas, drained and let it take on a little colour before you start moving it around.

Keep the lettuce, tomato and other fresh/crunchy ingredients out of the pan. Mix the measured sauce or dressing with the chickpeas, drained; if the filling is being served hot, reduce only the sauce-coated chickpeas, drained until it is no longer wet enough to soak the wrap.
Warm the wrap, then layer the filling through the centre with the fresh/crunchy elements last. Do not overfill it just because you can.
Fold in the sides, roll firmly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes if you want a crisp finish.

review.notes: Plain wholemeal wrap with chickpeas, fresh lettuce/tomato and peri-peri yoghurt. No unlisted garnish, cheese, seeds or substitutions. Dressing placement matches method.
